title.es: Aquel de demasiado poco tiempo a tu lado
title.en: The One With Too Little Time by Your Side

description.es: Marta les había encargado a las chicas de la tienda la tarea de preparar un regalo de boda, pero no había incluido a Fina en ella. Cuando Fina se entera de esto, se enfada mucho y va a hablar con Marta. Marta dice que no la incluyó porque sabía que a Fina le afectaba este matrimonio. Hablan sobre la boda, se abrazan y lloran. Aquí está la famosa frase que Fina le dice a Marta: "Porque solo una vida es demasiado poco tiempo a tu lado".
description.en: Marta had assigned the girls at the store the task of preparing a wedding gift but had not included Fina in it. When Fina hears about this, she becomes very angry and goes to talk to Marta. Marta says that she did not assign it to her because she knew Fina was affected by this marriage. They talk about the marriage, hug, and cry. Fina's famous line to Marta, "Because a single lifetime is far too little time by your side" is here.
